# Furnishings — PixelLab generation record

Provenance for the NSC-078 `furnishings` family. Cited by `PropCatalog.json` as
`provenance_document` for every entry below. Written by the Art Director Agent, 2026-09-22.

**Every sprite here was generated by PixelLab and by nothing else.** No local pixel edits, no
hand-painting, no scripted palette reduction: D-4 allows lossless crop/pad, masked PixelLab
inpaint, PixelLab's own `reduce_colors`, and regeneration. Colour reduction was
`reduce_colors` at 48 colours.

**Tool for every entry:** `create_object_pro_flash`, `view: "low top-down"`, style options
colour/outline/detail/shading. Rotations reuse the frontal through `first_frame_url` with
`n_directions: 8`, which reports `first_direction_generated: false` — the source direction is
not recharged and only the rotations are billed.

**Read the `how it was made` column before regenerating anything.** Where it does not say
"direct", the committed clause alone will not reproduce the shipped sprite.

## Shared rules

- **Pivot is the drawn ground line**, measured per sprite from the alpha bounds, never the
  canvas bottom. See `NSC-078_STYLE_LOCK.md`.
- **Rotation pads the canvas to square**, so a rotated sprite's pivot is re-measured and never
  carried from its frontal. Entries whose canvas differs from the plan say so in the table.
- **Palette is inherited through rotation**, so a source is judged before it is rotated: a
  defect in the frontal is multiplied into eight facings.
- **Spend is a subtraction between two meter readings at an empty queue**, never a sum of the
  per-call `estimated_generations`, which read a flat 6 across calls whose true average was
  5.87.
